posts.title: how ao3 creators see your comments
posts.description: If you’ve ever received a reply to a comment, it works the same way for creators. If you have comment emails turned on in your Preferences, you receive an email telling that you’ve received a comment. ( sidenote: this is, without fail, the best part of my day) ALT When I open up the email, I can tell immediately if the comment was left by a guest or by a logged in user. A guest’s name will be written in black text and will have (Guest) after it. A logged in user’s name will be in red text because it is a clickable link. It will have (Registered User) after it. ALT From this email, I can: reply to the comment - clicking this link takes me to the comment on its own page go to the thread starting from this comment - this will take me to the comment on its own page. If the comment is a reply to a previous comment, this will still be the first comment on the page and I will not see previous comments in the thread read all comments on [fic] - this will take me to the comment section of the c

posts.title: Fanart Frenzy is back!
posts.description: fanartfrenzy : As you may unfortunately be aware, scammers are still flooding fanfiction comments with art commission scams and bot comments. And we’re still sick of it! So Fanart Frenzy is back to help counteract these scammers and their impact on the fanfiction community, as well as raise awareness of their evolving scams. What is Fanart Frenzy? Fanart Frenzy is a month-long bingo event designed to bring a wave of fanfiction-inspired fanart into the community, entirely free and unsolicited, as fandom is supposed to be, in order to stem the flow of these scammers, encourage our favorite fic writers, and liven up our fandoms. This event is anti-AI - real, human-made art only! Our next event will take place from January 1-31, 2027. How does it work? You can sign up via our sign up form ! In late December, we’ll send our bingo card maker to each participant - create a card with prompts guiding you towards fics in your fandom to make art for. (Ex. Make art for a fic with no comments).
